input_basis: Existing UI distance-table layers only. LABLAB landscape analysis, class_km, landscape_type and F1-F5 are intentionally not used in this version.
score_behavior: All Bornholm R10 hexes remain in the output and always receive continuous wind and solar placement scores. Hard stops are saved as flags and reasons; they do not remove hexes and do not zero the final score.
runtime_intent: Use these scores as the primary soft ranking signal within the potential surface chosen by the user. Potential filters decide which hexes are candidates; selected establishment hexes are allocated by descending combined allocation_priority_score.
v3_candidate_behavior: Move this contract to V3 if review is positive: user-selected potential area is the candidate set, establishment_placement_score is the suitability ranking, allocation is score-ranked, and hard_stop flags are explanatory review metadata.

aggregation_method.parent: R10 hex_id mapped to H3 R9 parent with h3.cell_to_parent.
aggregation_method.scores: Continuous scores and component columns are arithmetic means over R10 child hexes.
aggregation_method.distances: Distance columns use the minimum R10 child distance inside each R9 parent.
aggregation_method.eligibility: R9 eligible is true if any R10 child is eligible.
aggregation_method.hard_stop: R9 hard_stop is true only when all R10 children are hard_stop for that technology.
aggregation_method.reasons: Reason fields are semicolon-separated unions; exclusion_reason is retained only for all-hard-stop R9 parents.
